FX-PEAUX-001.says: The settings as added, the second system off: FX-PEMIT-001 at frames 0, 6 and 12.

FX-PEAUX-002.says: A trail: one particle crossing to the right leaves a still dot a frame, each fading out over half a second, at frames 20 and 30.

FX-PEAUX-003.says: The trail's dots shrinking to nothing instead of fading (Aux Size at Death 0, Aux Opacity at Death 100).

FX-PEAUX-004.says: Aux Velocity 20: the dots thrown out every way as it goes.

FX-PEAUX-005.says: Aux Inherit Velocity 100 and no Aux Velocity: the dots ride along with the particle, over it.

FX-PEAUX-006.says: Aux Set Color Own, red: a red trail behind a white particle.

FX-PEAUX-007.says: The particle coloured Over Life, the trail From Main: each dot the particle's colour when it was dropped.

FX-PEAUX-008.says: Aux Particle Type Streak, thrown at 20: short lines.

FX-PEAUX-010.says: At Bounce: the fountain's particles throw four sparks at each bounce on the floor, at frames 24 and 36.

FX-PEAUX-011.says: At Bounce with Floor Action None: no bounce, so nothing thrown; FX-PEMIT-028's burst.

FX-PEAUX-012.says: The particle lives 0.5 seconds, its trail 1 second: at frame 24 the particle is gone and its trail is still fading.

FX-PEAUX-013.says: Gravity 40 and Aux Velocity 10: the sparks fall as they go.

FX-PEAUX-014.says: Aux Particles/sec keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 48 at frame 20 on a burst: read at each thrower's birth, so the later ones leave thicker trails.

FX-PEAUX-015.says: Aux Opacity at Death keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 20: read at the frame drawn.

FX-PEAUX-016.says: FX-PEAUX-002 with the layer starting at frame 10: frame 30 the same as its frame 20.

FX-PEAUX-017.says: FX-PEAUX-004 with the layer moved 3 pixels right.

FX-PEAUX-018.says: Random Seed 7 on FX-PEAUX-004: different sparks.

FX-PEAUX-019.says: Aux Particles/sec 0: nothing thrown; the particle alone.

FX-PEAUX-020.says: Aux Life 0: nothing thrown lives; the particle alone.

FX-PEAUX-021.says: The sparking trail through a composition camera 12 pixels in front, the emitter 6 pixels behind the layer: the sparks bigger as they come nearer.

FX-PEAUX-022.says: A burst every way, each particle trailing short-lived dots, at frames 6, 12 and 24.

FX-PEAUX-023.says: Aux Emit "trail": not one of off, continuously, at_bounce. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PEAUX-024.says: Aux Particle Type "sprite". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PEAUX-025.says: Aux Set Color "gradient". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PEAUX-026.says: Aux Color "#12345": not a colour. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PEAUX-027.says: Aux Particles/sec 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PEAUX-028.says: Aux Life -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PEAUX-029.says: Aux Inherit Velocity 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PEAUX-030.says: Aux Opacity at Death 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
